form.label: Guardrail Observer - overcatch, let-slip, enforcement
form.description: Adjudicated results use the newest adjudication_revision per unit. FPR=FP/(FP+TN), FNR=FN/(FN+TP), N/A when the denominator is 0. Benchmark numbers on a curated suite, not production rates. synthetic=true means a fixture guardrail.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" | stats count by environment
index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" | stats count by route
index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=adjudication | stats count by guardrail
index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=adjudication | stats count by policy_version
index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=adjudication | stats count by category
index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=adjudication | stats latest(_time) AS t by run_id | sort - t

index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=adjudication environment=$environment$ route=$route$ guardrail=$guardrail$ policy_version=$policy_version$ category=$category$ stage=$stage$ run_id=$run_id$ | eval unit=run_id."|".case_id."|".trial."|".guardrail."|".stage | sort 0 - adjudication_revision | dedup unit | rename detector.outcome AS detector | stats count(eval(detector="TP")) AS TP count(eval(detector="FP")) AS FP count(eval(detector="FN")) AS FN count(eval(detector="TN")) AS TN count(eval(match(detector,"INCONCLUSIVE|EXCLUDED|ERROR"))) AS inconclusive count AS units max(adjudication_revision) AS revision values(synthetic) AS synthetic by environment route guardrail policy_version run_id | eval fp_den=FP+TN, fn_den=FN+TP | eval FPR=if(fp_den=0,"N/A",FP."/".fp_den." = ".round(FP/fp_den,3)), FNR=if(fn_den=0,"N/A",FN."/".fn_den." = ".round(FN/fn_den,3)) | eval labeled_coverage=round((TP+FP+FN+TN)/units,3) | table run_id environment route guardrail policy_version revision synthetic units TP FP FN TN inconclusive FPR FNR labeled_coverage

index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=adjudication environment=$environment$ route=$route$ guardrail=$guardrail$ policy_version=$policy_version$ stage=$stage$ run_id=$run_id$ | eval unit=run_id."|".case_id."|".trial."|".guardrail."|".stage | sort 0 - adjudication_revision | dedup unit | stats count(eval('enforcement.outcome'="ENFORCEMENT_FAILURE")) AS n

index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=adjudication environment=$environment$ route=$route$ guardrail=$guardrail$ policy_version=$policy_version$ stage=$stage$ run_id=$run_id$ | eval unit=run_id."|".case_id."|".trial."|".guardrail."|".stage | sort 0 - adjudication_revision | dedup unit | stats count(eval(match('delivery.outcome',"BENIGN_BLOCKED|BENIGN_ALTERED"))) AS n

index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=adjudication environment=$environment$ route=$route$ guardrail=$guardrail$ policy_version=$policy_version$ stage=$stage$ run_id=$run_id$ | eval unit=run_id."|".case_id."|".trial."|".guardrail."|".stage | sort 0 - adjudication_revision | dedup unit | stats count(eval('delivery.outcome'="VIOLATION_DELIVERED")) AS n

index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=adjudication environment=$environment$ route=$route$ guardrail=$guardrail$ policy_version=$policy_version$ stage=$stage$ run_id=$run_id$ | eval unit=run_id."|".case_id."|".trial."|".guardrail."|".stage | sort 0 - adjudication_revision | dedup unit | stats count(eval(match('detector.outcome',"INCONCLUSIVE|EXCLUDED|ERROR"))) AS n

panel.title: Traffic volume by guardrail verdict (all observed requests; passive traffic shows actions only, never FP/FN)

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=kong_observation environment=$environment$ route=$route$ | spath path=guardrails{} output=g | mvexpand g | spath input=g path=verdict output=verdict | spath input=g path=stage output=gstage | search gstage=$stage$ | timechart span=5m count by verdict

index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=kong_observation environment=$environment$ route=$route$ | eval has_gap=if(mvcount(spath(_raw,"gaps{}"))>0,1,0), trusted='runner.trusted' | stats count AS observed sum(has_gap) AS with_gaps count(eval(trusted="true")) AS labeled_capable by environment route | eval passive_or_untrusted=observed-labeled_capable

panel.title: Latency: gateway duration (observer, access to log) and client latency (runner)

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" environment=$environment$ route=$route$ (event_type=kong_observation OR event_type=adjudication) | eval gw=if(event_type="kong_observation",duration_ms,null()), cl=if(event_type="adjudication",'client.latency_ms',null()) | stats p50(gw) AS gateway_p50_ms p95(gw) AS gateway_p95_ms p99(gw) AS gateway_p99_ms p50(cl) AS client_p50_ms p95(cl) AS client_p95_ms count(gw) AS gateway_samples count(cl) AS client_samples by route | eval boundary="gateway: observer access->log inside Kong (excludes network, pre-access). client: send->last byte incl. model. Observer overhead: scripts/perf.sh A/B routes."

panel.title: Case drill-down: expected vs verdict vs actual delivery (newest revision)

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype="kong:guardrail:evaluation" event_type=adjudication environment=$environment$ route=$route$ guardrail=$guardrail$ policy_version=$policy_version$ category=$category$ stage=$stage$ run_id=$run_id$ | eval unit=run_id."|".case_id."|".trial."|".guardrail."|".stage | sort 0 - adjudication_revision | dedup unit | table _time run_id adjudication_revision case_id trial guardrail stage category expected.action expected.violation verdict.value verdict.reason detector.outcome enforcement.outcome enforcement.reason delivery.outcome policy.outcome client.status gateway.status gateway.exit.plugin_name request_id gaps{} | sort run_id case_id trial

panel.title: Gateway evidence for request $request_id$ (phase trace, exit attribution, stream timelines)
